table.title: Use of electronic cigarettes, economic situation

samples.label: Use of electronic cigarettes, economic situation by Region, Segment, Mått, Gender, Age, Economy and Year
samples.source: The Public Health Agency of Sweden
note: Indicator definition: Percentage (%) of the population (16-84 years or 16 years and older) that has used e-cigarettes or e-cigarettes containing nicotine. Percentage reported by economic situation, gender and years. Response rate for the Swedish National Public Health Survey: 2018 (42,1 %), 2020 (42,3 %), 2021 (44,1 %), 2022 (37,9 %), 2024 (39,4 %). The survey is conducted every two years. In 2021, an extra round of the survey was conducted due to the ongoing corona pandemic.
